newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Andrx started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Andrx started as buy.

text.p: -- Dillon Read said on Monday it has initiated coverage of Andrx Corp with a buy rating.
-- The brokerage firm estimated the Ft. Lauderdale, Fla.-based generic drug maker's earnings will grow to $3.36 a share in the year 2000, compared with an estimated loss of $0.39 a share in 1997.
-- Based on that earnings growth, Dillon has set a 12-month price target at $42 for the stock.
-- Andrx shares were trading down $0.75 at $21 on Monday.
